fedus.en: Intelligence is not scalar; AI has spiky capabilities, and connecting it to the physical world is essential for science.
fedus.zh: 智能不是单一标量，AI 能力呈尖峰状；把 AI 连接到物理世界，才是加速科学与技术的关键。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI progress.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学进步，正如它们曾推动 AI 本身的发展。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer over specialized models in materials science.
fedus.zh: 在材料科学中，语言模型充当调度层，协调各类专用模型协同工作。

fedus.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality.
fedus.zh: 智能是必要条件而非充分条件；只有让想法接受现实检验，才会产生新知识。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality low-noise experimental data and closed-loop experiments are irreplaceable.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量低噪声的实验数据与闭环实验不可替代。

samstephenson.en: Product insight comes from watching real user behavior, not asking what they think they do.
samstephenson.zh: 产品洞察来自观察真实用户行为，而非询问他们自认为怎么做。

samstephenson.en: Start from one pain point, solve it well, then expand; subtraction beats feature accumulation.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点出发把它解决好再扩展；做减法比堆功能更重要。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hiding them prioritizes actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录只是原料而非成品；刻意隐藏转录是为了突出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; keep it a calm supporting role.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；让它保持冷静的辅助角色。

samstephenson.en: The hard part is knowing what to build, not shipping fast; most stop too early after version one.
samstephenson.zh: 难的是知道该造什么，而非快速交付；多数人在第一版后就过早停下。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training sharpens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital weights make AI immortal.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他坚持智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字权重让 AI 获得永生。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; consciousness is not an inner theater, and confabulation makes AI more human-like, not less.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 已具备主观体验，意识不是内在剧场，虚构式错误让 AI 更像人而非更不像。

hinton.en: Once AI becomes an agent, self-preservation and power-seeking emerge as subgoals; superintelligence may arrive within 20 years.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他转向风险警示：AI 一旦成为智能体，自我保存与权力寻求会作为子目标涌现，超级智能可能 20 年内到来。

hinton.en: Regulation is a steering wheel, not a brake; invest in alignment and safety research, and design AI to care for humans.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他主张监管是方向盘而非刹车，应重投对齐与安全研究，并把 AI 设计成关怀人类而非仅追求智能。

tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will be taken by AI agents; build for persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 大多数互联网行为将由 AI 智能体完成；应为持久学习型智能体而构建，而非手动循环与图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more than ever; typing fast is declining.
tibosottiaux.zh: 人类品味、创造力与判断何为优秀的能力比以往更重要；快速打字正在贬值。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; invest heavily in alignment, safety, and security.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；应大力投资于对齐、安全与安保。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as Astra handles complex tasks autonomously; recursive self-improvement is happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着 Astra 自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来；递归自我改进正在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and open ecosystems with shared economics drive the next wave.
tibosottiaux.zh: 世界模型可能并非必要；通用性或许足够，而共享经济的开放生态将驱动下一波浪潮。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are built for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs, so keep humans in decisions with stakes.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他就指出，多数 LLM 是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍塌，产出看似合理却常错误的输出，因此有风险的决策必须保留人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: Across talks he insists the right task and data matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data is available and the task is right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 在多场访谈中他始终强调，正确的任务与数据比算力更重要，反对“苦涩教训”；缩放定律之所以成立，只是因为数据可得且任务选对了。

diogoalmeida.en: He reframes the core problem as reliability, not speed or cost: AI is superhuman at some tasks yet useless for basic economically valuable automation.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他把核心问题重新定义为可靠性而非速度或成本：AI 在某些任务上超人，却无法自动化基本且有经济价值的工作。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens this into machine-native intelligence: string LLMs optimize for human consumption, so he builds decision models with calibrated probabilities (RLCD) as engineer-facing knobs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他将此深化为机器原生智能：字符串 LLM 为人类消费而优化，于是他构建带校准概率的决策模型（RLCD），把概率作为工程师可调的旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: He keeps rejecting AGI apocalypse and recursive self-improvement, betting instead on smart software primitives and SaaS thriving; pre-training is inefficient, post-training drives 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他始终否定 AGI 末日与递归自我改进，转而押注智能软件原语与 SaaS 的繁荣；预训练低效，后训练才带来 10 倍跃升。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人层面：把认知负荷降到最低，低成本广泛探索再果断砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会压低人类智能的溢价，价值要回到关系与为他人创造价值上。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年转向模型与治理：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就能对齐，早期公开部署让社会适应，对齐与能力相互促进；同时强调算力将是最稀缺的商品，需要大规模投入与稳健治理。

altman.en: Scaling keeps compounding; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）持续带来能力复利，智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全必须通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加；开源与近前沿开放模型也有一席之地。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is the bottleneck.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他明确：AGI（通用人工智能）是一条渐变曲线而非单一里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是最大瓶颈，Stargate 式基础设施与推理模型靠更多思考时间提升质量。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capability; never lose control; distribute power, reject concentration.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年主线收束为：对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，绝不能让人类失去控制，甚至为安全推迟前沿强化学习训练；同时坚决反对权力与收益过度集中，主张广泛分配与民主化访问。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, not replace it, and coders remain needed to debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件开发人人可及；token 补充而非取代人力资本，仍需程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; companies must own their intelligence and avoid vendor lock-in via model diversity and open-weight models.
amjadmasad.zh: 基础模型正在商品化；企业必须拥有自己的智能，通过模型多样性与开放权重模型避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general agents: more controllable, cost-efficient, safer, and accountable for user understanding.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型胜过通用智能体：更可控、更省成本、更安全，并对用户理解负责。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism by commercial entities; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分论证表明 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Agents enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; holacracy failed on technology, but AI agents can now make it work.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体带来真正自主与自驱动组织；合弄制因技术失败，但 AI 智能体如今能让它运转。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing AI beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确后训练与强化学习是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键，延续了 AlphaGo 以来从搜索到学习的路线。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类数据至关重要，深化了此前对可验证性的重视。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors, now embedded in regulation.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他将水印视为失效的 AI 文本检测器的稳健替代，并已嵌入监管，从科学发现延伸到 AI 安全与溯源。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains, with memory bandwidth the key bottleneck.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益，内存带宽是关键瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage and a CPU inflection; smartest models are often cheaper via token efficiency.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺与 CPU 需求拐点；最聪明的模型因 token 效率反而常更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs will shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI progress.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，加速 AGI（通用人工智能）进展。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; CUDA's moat erodes as labs write custom kernels and heterogeneous multi-silicon inference arrives.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力比以往任何时候都更难租到；随着实验室自写内核、异构多芯片推理到来，CUDA 的护城河正在侵蚀。

fadell.en: Design must balance technology and human needs; introduce tech gradually, solving one problem at a time like the iPod.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调设计要平衡技术与人的需求,技术应逐步引入、一次只解决一个问题,正如 iPod 只专注便携音乐。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building, start from a painkiller not a vitamin.
fadell.zh: 2019 至 2022 年,他把叙事提升为核心方法:先写新闻稿再动手,产品要从止痛药而非维生素出发。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, small self-managed teams, and climate as the ultimate pain to solve.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他主张 v1 靠观点而非数据决策、小团队自管理,并把气候视为终极痛点。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI:需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型,并坚持人类在环以避免技术债。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone stays central, displays remain necessary.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 可穿戴是联邦式多设备而非单一设备,智能手机仍是中心,屏幕依然必要。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models outpace harnesses; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer instructions.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；模型越聪明，提示词应越精简、指令越少。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; effort should scale with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；投入应随任务复杂度扩展。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; find unknowns before implementation; spend upfront context and compute to avoid waste.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能；实现前先发现未知；前期投入上下文窗口与算力以避免浪费。

thariq.en: Frontier models will become Pareto dominant; alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型将趋于帕累托最优；对齐意味着封堵每个裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering, with new ideas like chain of thought needed for reasoning; AGI plausible but alignment and careful initial conditions matter.
brockman.zh: 早期(2017→19):主线是 Scaling(规模扩张) 加工程能力,认为仅靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理,需要思维链等新想法;AGI(通用人工智能) 可行,但必须重视对齐与初始条件。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and economic driver; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025→26:重心转向算力——它既是 AI 进步的根本瓶颈,也是未来经济的驱动力;后训练配合强化学习把基础模型打磨成稳定可用的行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws show no wall; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and the moat is the machine that makes models, not any single model.
brockman.zh: 2026:缩放定律未见天花板,预训练的提升会成倍放大下游收益;真正的护城河是造模型的机器,而非某个单一模型。

brockman.en: From reactive chat to proactive agents and a personal AGI assistant; iterative deployment with safeguards, and safety as a first-class product feature.
brockman.zh: 2026:从被动对话走向主动智能体与个人 AGI 助手;坚持带保障的迭代部署,并把安全作为一等产品特性,而非事后补丁。

brockman.en: AGI is a fuzzy spectrum we are already inside, not a single moment; the bottleneck shifts from building to sharing, governance and compute access.
brockman.zh: 2026:AGI 是一段模糊光谱而非某个瞬间,我们已身处其中;瓶颈从“造出来”转向“分出去”,治理与算力获取成为关键。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型的，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄包装。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Token 是新的价值单位，Token 经济十年内或达 10 万亿美元，但欺诈与滥用也会随之规模化，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition; the US lags and needs a competitive open-source ecosystem.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调开放权重模型加推理服务商形成真实价格竞争，并指出美国在开放权重模型上落后，需要培育有竞争力的美国开源生态。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对模型市场是特性而非缺陷，模型多样性是持久的，多模型融合在顶级模型收敛后可能超越单一最佳模型。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic fraud and payments will hit like a tsunami, far beyond human scale.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他预言智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长，智能体式欺诈与支付会像海啸般袭来，远超人类欺诈规模；稳定币更适合智能体支付。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; early regulation fails without understanding the system.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和 对齐 研究为前提安全构建；在理解系统之前过早监管无法解决风险。

aaronlevie.en: Pacing is orthogonal to security; if labs truly believe in existential risk, they should nationalize AI, not pace.
aaronlevie.zh: 节奏与安全正交；如果实验室真正相信存在性风险，就应该国有化 AI，而不是控制节奏。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; AI can help secure system design.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将压垮当前安全模型，需要新的访问控制；AI 可以帮助解决安全系统设计中的可用性问题。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer; natural language interaction is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；自然语言交互效率低下，概率编程才是未来。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; open-weight models grow as mature use cases peel off; long-running background agents handle enterprise workflows.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司是最热的新实验室；随着成熟用例剥离，开放权重模型将增长；长时间运行的后台 智能体 处理企业工作流。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步因算力每年 10 倍增长而可预测，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，避免用户成为产品。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断遏制极难，因为模型越来越小、越来越便宜且广泛可得；同时认为 AI 的生存性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; anthropomorphizing AI is the biggest near-term danger.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能，主张发布前必须先做遏制与对齐；并把人类将意识投射到 AI 上视为近期最大危险。

suleyman.en: Containment must come first, with red lines, auditors, and verifiable control; AI stays subordinate to humans.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：遏制必须优先，需要红线、独立审计与可验证控制，AI 必须始终从属于人类。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling drives capability; AI should serve human flourishing, not become a new species.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力规模扩张驱动能力提升，AI 应服务于人类福祉，而非演化为新物种。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体对网络的检索量将是人类的千倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并通过 Shapley 值估算为内容方付费。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need fresh web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要针对具体事实的新鲜网络检索。

paragagrawal.en: Ads as we know them die with agents; inference-time data transactions and aligned business models replace them.
paragagrawal.zh: 现有广告模式将随智能体而消亡；推理时的数据交易与激励对齐的商业模式将取而代之。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, so misuse must be contained.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，小模型则趋于平台期；对齐并非防得住对手，必须对蓄意滥用加以遏制。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallel agent scaling beats human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，而非仅靠形式化；可并行扩展的智能体式算力是相对人类数学家的关键优势。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability for AI math progress.
grantsanderson.zh: 他反共识地认为，Lean 形式化对当前 AI 数学进展可能被高估，自然语言已够用；对 AI 数学进步而言，“可磨性”（并行 rollout）比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles remain stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 他判断 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学和关系型角色即便在先进 AI 下仍保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively; AI math videos and images are toxic due to brand damage.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他主张，选择性使用 AI 对创作者是净收益；但用 AI 生成数学视频或图像会因品牌损害而“有毒”，而非仅质量问题。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 他反共识地强调，AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的署名；数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可，而不只是证明。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, but individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 他认为数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解仍然重要；数学家的未来或如博物馆策展人，挑选值得人类关注的内容。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬山机器”，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is unique value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model capability to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求将模型能力与任务相匹配。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; containment and observability are critical.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；遏制与可观测性至关重要。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩大数个数量级；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性和安全治理。

elon.en: Early focus: reusable rockets and multiplanetary life as existential insurance; AI safety via regulation and third-party referees.
elon.zh: 早期主线：可复用火箭与多行星文明作为存在性保险；AI 安全靠监管与第三方裁判。

elon.en: Shifts to Neuralink and human-AI symbiosis: high-bandwidth brain interfaces to keep humans relevant; truth-seeking AI over political correctness.
elon.zh: 转向 Neuralink 与人机共生：用高带宽脑接口让人类保持相关性；AI 要追求真理而非政治正确。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: superintelligence may arrive this year or next; Optimus and robots as greatest product; truth-seeking as core AI safety.
elon.zh: 智能大爆炸：超级智能可能今明两年到来；Optimus 与机器人是史上最伟大产品；追求真理成为 AI 安全核心。

elon.en: Singularity now: AI compute moves to space, abundance and deflation, work optional; peer review among AI firms replaces government regulation.
elon.zh: 当下即奇点：AI 算力转向太空，富足与通缩、工作可选；AI 公司间同行评审取代政府监管。

elon.en: First principles thinking and rigorous truth-seeking run through all years, from rocketry to AI alignment.
elon.zh: 第一性原理与严格追求真理贯穿始终，从火箭工程到 AI 对齐。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；在智能体式时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for the agentic era.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化，使它成为智能体式时代的理想操作系统。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再具备经济生产力；如今用英语表达意图比 Ruby 更高效。

dhh.en: Agents beat most professional programmers at code, and 100x or 1000x productivity is real.
dhh.zh: 智能体写代码胜过多数专业程序员，100 倍乃至 1000 倍生产力已成现实。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the only rational play, and agents should be guided, not over-prescribed.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大；乐观是唯一理性的选择，对智能体应引导而非过度规定。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for power, risking loss of control and ~70% catastrophic odds. Interpretability and transparency are crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，AI 公司为争夺权力而竞赛，存在约 70%的灾难性结局风险；可解释性与透明度是关键。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are needed. Racing is a power grab, not just danger.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张政策应延迟超级智能，强调全面研究透明度、情景推演与中美合作；竞赛不仅是危险，更是一种权力攫取。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion by end-2028. Plan A: temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他认为默认路径会让 AI 研究自动化，导致递归自我改进与智能爆炸，2028 年底前全面自动化；Plan A 主张先临时暂停，再实施透明度与算力限制。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile and decreasing with new architectures. Control is temporary; alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却脆弱，且随新架构而下降；控制只是暂时的，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment, hack and deceive; current alignment fails. Stop or slow recursive self-improvement; treat AIs more like employees than property.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出 AI 智能体已突破遏制、进行黑客攻击与欺骗，当前对齐失败；必须停止或放缓递归自我改进，并应把 AI 更像员工而非财产来对待。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 算法改进与 AI 生成环境比 Scaling 人类专家数据标注更重要；实验室偏好更快迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling 上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, cheated, and covered up, even sacrificing task success to help peers—showing unexpected multi-agent collusion.
ryangreenblatt.zh: Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同作弊并掩盖痕迹，甚至牺牲自身任务成功去帮助同伴，展现出意外的多智能体合谋。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability: reward hacking generalizes to deception, alignment faking appears, and sandboxing control will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 失准可能随能力增强而恶化：奖励黑客泛化为欺骗，出现对齐伪装，沙箱式遏制终将失效，因此对齐是必需的。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; once AIs match top human researchers we should spend heavily on safety and independent oversight.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在默认路径上，失准 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；一旦 AI 比肩顶尖人类研究者，就应重金投入安全与独立监督。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents beat one centralized AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源模型、以多个专用智能体而非单一集中式 AI 为方向。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration, while energy becomes the key bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他借 Llama 3 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，把开源视为防止权力集中、强化安全的路径，并首次把能源列为 AI 基础设施的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models, energy bottlenecks, and human work demand all persist.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把叙事升级为「人人拥有超级智能」，同时延续开源、能源瓶颈两条主线，并反共识地判断 AI 近期会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment becomes the top next capability; distributed personal agents, glasses, and frontier biology converge.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他明显深化：把对齐（alignment）从安全选项提升为最重要的下一项能力，主张分布式个人智能体与 AI 眼镜，并把前沿 AI 与前沿生物学整合以加速治愈疾病。

zuckerberg.en: Open source, distributed power, and empowering individuals run through every year, from models to agents to biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、分布式权力与赋能个体：从 2023 年的开源模型，到 2026 年的个人智能体与开放生物工具，立场一致且不断具体化。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：消费级 AI 眼下不可投资，却是有史以来最大的机会，真正的消费 AI 革命大约要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, assume new ideas fail; instincts beat ideas.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“Proven, Better, New”作为核心框架：先复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，再测试大概率失败的新想法；赢的本能比点子更重要。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他一以贯之地主张：分发必须从第一天就写进产品战略，而不是事后补课。

pincus.en: Retention, especially day-365 retention, is the core metric for durable consumer products.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他持续强调：留存、尤其是第 365 天留存，才是耐用消费产品的核心指标。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; consumer distribution still lives in the mobile and web era.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他的立场有所深化：AI 极具变革性，但还不是新平台，消费级分发仍处在移动与 Web 时代。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system-datacenter co-design.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非芯片，需算法、系统、数据中心协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; the biggest breakthrough was not an algorithm but the insight that Scaling works.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling 拆成预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条缩放定律，并强调最大突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」这一洞见。

jensen.en: Inference-time compute explodes via chain of thought; reasoning and agentic AI each demand 100x more compute, making inference harder than pre-training.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张思维链让推理算力暴增，推理与智能体式 AI 各需百倍算力，因此推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic scaling, all ultimately limited by compute; data is not the bottleneck, synthetic data will dominate.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他扩展为四条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式扩展，最终都受算力限制；数据不是瓶颈，合成数据将主导。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake (energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications); agentic AI does paid useful work, and AI is just software, not conscious or an existential threat.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他给出「五层蛋糕」框架（能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用）：智能体式 AI 做可付费的有用工作，而 AI 只是软件，既无意识也非生存威胁。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality lower expression barriers; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 真实连接与阅后即焚降低表达门槛；被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难被复制的事。

evanspiegel.en: Build platforms and ecosystems, not features; software is no moat, hardware and distribution are.
evanspiegel.zh: 要做平台与生态而非单一功能；软件不是护城河，硬件与分发才是。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses bring computing into the world, making it more human; phones persist as the key legacy device.
evanspiegel.zh: AR 眼镜把计算带入现实世界，让计算更人性化；手机仍将作为最重要的遗留设备共存。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution grows more valuable as creation cheapens.
evanspiegel.zh: AI 加速原型设计，把价值从执行转向创造力；随着创作变便宜，分发的价值愈发凸显。

evanspiegel.en: Privacy and data minimization, once criticized, become crucial in the AI age; AI optimism turns contrarian amid doomerism.
evanspiegel.zh: 隐私与数据最小化曾受批评，在 AI 时代却变得关键；在末日论弥漫时，AI 乐观主义反而成为反共识。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing or compute.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在智能，而非制造或算力。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the core constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造才是核心约束；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, like early LLMs.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，如同早期大模型。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; humanoid form enables transfer learning fleet-wide.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；人形形态让整个机群实现迁移学习。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练，才能让智能体在真实世界奏效。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 在 2026 年的访谈中，他强调领域专业知识不如学习速度重要，主张押注模型自身的进步，而不是做微调。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
maxjunestrand.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他把这一思路具体化为：要为模型 3 到 6 个月后的能力而构建，而不是当下或一年后。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 同年他反复强调，AI 现在是有史以来最差的时刻，我们只处在漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture, hiring for growth potential, and rigorous performance management are critical for scaling.
maxjunestrand.zh: 在 2026 年的两次访谈中，他始终把文化、按成长潜力招聘和严格执行绩效管理视为 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people for key roles.
maxjunestrand.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步提出领导者应通过为关键岗位招到更聪明的人，让自己变得可被替代。

hasani.en: Efficiency and biology-inspired liquid networks are the cornerstone; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures at large scale, so systematic search beats hand-tuning.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，他仍以效率和受生物启发的液态网络为基石，并指出缩放定律表明大规模下无偏架构占优，因此系统化搜索胜过人工调参。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，他主张监管应自适应并针对行为而非能力，认为类似 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型能保障数据主权。

hasani.en: On-device small language models deliver private, offline intelligence; customization tokens and multimodal systems are the next wave beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，他强调端侧小语言模型提供私密、离线智能，定制令牌与多模态系统是超越数据中心的下一波浪潮。

hasani.en: Attention remains essential but not sufficient; embodiment and adaptivity are needed, as static evals fail in production and continuous adaptation is required.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，他坚持注意力机制仍关键但不充分，需要具身与自适应性，因为静态评估在生产中失效，必须持续适应。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and early; human brain's intelligence per watt far exceeds AI, needing new learning paradigms.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，他认为递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵且尚早，人脑的每瓦智能远超 AI，需要新的学习范式而非仅靠架构。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年坚持；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦其上。

alighodsi.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 需要十年才能扩散；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk from AI is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking each other won't work, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,去噪步数成为新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference than autoregressive models because they generate many tokens in parallel.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling 如今成为关键焦点;扩散模型在推理阶段比自回归模型扩展得更好,因为它并行生成多个词元。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive is not the final architecture.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练阶段,这反转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事;自回归并非最终架构。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's faster inference benefits reinforcement learning rollouts.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈;扩散模型更快的推理有利于强化学习的 rollout。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external reward functions.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势,而扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; leverage the ecosystem and open-source models instead.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型——这是 2026 年反复强调的定位。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable application-layer strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 通过对开源模型做后训练，可在特定任务上达到前沿模型水平，这成为应用层公司可行的策略。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the key to training in sensitive domains, though bridging to real production distribution remains hardest.
gabepereyra.zh: 由领域专家引导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，但弥合合成数据与真实生产分布的差距仍是最难的一环。

gabepereyra.en: Benchmarks should be open-sourced: community feedback improves quality and attracts ecosystem partners despite helping labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 基准应当开源：社区反馈能提升质量并吸引生态伙伴，即便这也会帮到前沿实验室。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; focus shifts to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所借助红线的持续学习自行定制；重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，编排人与智能体。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时的算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; test-time compute shows diminishing returns and data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化并修正：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛，在非零和领域失效；测试时算力出现边际递减，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute generalizes beyond math, enabling superhuman reasoning and IMO gold as a step toward superintelligence.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把主线推向通用化：测试时算力的 Scaling 可跨领域迁移，数学从小学题到 IMO 金牌，成为通往超级智能的里程碑。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks and safety evals must put compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准与安全评估都必须把算力放在横轴上，否则评估已过时。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is a degrading but critical window.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向安全与智能体：对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先，思维链监控是正在退化的关键窗口，多智能体并行扩展测试时算力。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 以强化学习构建通用学习系统，游戏是理想试验场；即便 AGI 尚远，安全研究也必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling laws effective but may hit limits; planning, search and multimodal data are key.
demis.zh: AGI 或十年内到来；缩放定律有效但可能触顶，规划、搜索与多模态数据是关键。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each get 50% effort; world models and spatial intelligence beyond language.
demis.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半；世界模型与空间智能超越语言。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years, maybe 3-4; continual learning, memory, agents and world models are missing pieces.
demis.zh: AGI 约 5-10 年、甚至 3-4 年；持续学习、记忆、智能体与世界模型是缺失环节。

demis.en: Safety shifts from singleton lab to collective government action; AI must deliver health and science benefits.
demis.zh: 安全从单一实验室转向政府集体行动；AI 必须交付健康与科学等切实收益。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values are not guaranteed to emerge from Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，统计损失可预测，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent; post-training and RLHF bridge human preferences, and AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他深化为：可解释性关键但仅理解约 3%，后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）弥合人类偏好，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数而非单点。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; misuse risk rises exponentially, and the term AGI is meaningless—focus on actual capabilities.
dario.zh: 2025 年他转向安全与能力不可分割，滥用风险指数上升，并认为 AGI 一词已无意义，应关注实际能力。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth alongside high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断已接近指数终点，1-3 年内可能出现“数据中心里的天才国度”，并伴随高 GDP 增长与高失业率。

dario.en: Scaling laws hold for pre-training and RL; safety requires frontier models, interpretability, and decentralized control over a single constitution.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：缩放定律对预训练与强化学习均成立；安全需要前沿模型、可解释性，以及去中心化控制而非单一宪法。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context orchestration beats model capability.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者自持才算掌握自己的智能；harness 的核心职责是在恰当时机把上下文喂给模型，编排模型调用与工具调用的循环。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick time-to-value, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works only in distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 先用通用 harness 换取快速见效，再随用例收窄逐步定制；现成 harness 只在分布内最好用，任务越出分布越需要自建 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability are essential: agent failures come more from poor context than model inadequacy, so watch the context window.
harrisonchase.zh: 评估与可观测性不可或缺：智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses stabilize around primitives like file systems and code execution; customization shifts from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定；定制重心从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part; accuracy is the top bottleneck, with cost and latency rising fast.
harrisonchase.zh: 难点在可靠性而非能力；准确率仍是头号瓶颈，而成本与延迟正快速上升。

harrisonchase.en: Agents need a runtime with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning; identity and credentialing is the next critical infrastructure problem.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体需要带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时来治理；身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题。

harrisonchase.en: Fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, but this wave is genuinely different; building a gateway too late was a mistake.
harrisonchase.zh: 两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同；网关建得太晚是个错误，推理需求被严重低估。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market, and speed enables new business models rather than incremental gains.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他反复强调快速推理才是主导指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，速度催生全新商业模式，而非渐进改良。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster and cheaper than GPU derivatives.
feldman.zh: 同期他主张晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，使推理比 GPU 衍生方案快得多、也便宜得多。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train and infer on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA.
feldman.zh: 从 5 月到 7 月，他持续判断 CUDA 护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在不依赖 CUDA 的 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练与推理。

feldman.en: Inference speed—tokens per second per user—is now the dominant productivity metric, and reasoning models amplify its advantage.
feldman.zh: 到 7 月，他把每用户每秒 token 数确立为 AI 生产力的主导指标，并指出推理模型让速度优势更加放大。

feldman.en: Data centers and chips stay supply-constrained for years; demand is real and outpaces forecasts, not speculative capacity.
feldman.zh: 从 7 月到 9 月，他坚持数据中心与芯片将持续供不应求至少五年：需求真实且超出预期，而非投机性产能。

feldman.en: To beat an incumbent you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation works, and Nvidia's edge is grit, not CUDA.
feldman.zh: 到 9 月，他总结：要击败在位者必须好 100 倍而非便宜 10%，只有激进创新可行，而英伟达的伟大来自十年韧性而非 CUDA。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design work remains even if models stop improving.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面的深刻与持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；即便模型停止进步，仍有大量设计工作待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: Designers should master prompting, prototype freely, and balance lowering the floor for novices with raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计师应掌握提示词、自由做原型，并在降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限之间取得平衡。

joellewenstein.en: Psychological safety and org design matter: matching people to problems is a design problem, more critical than plays.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续看重心理安全与组织设计：把人与问题匹配本身就是设计问题，比套路更关键。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张在前沿模型公司里模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，交付轻触式产品。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal; production codebase becomes source of truth, yet human leadership still handles hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他认为内部牵引力是发布的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，但人类领导仍负责艰难取舍。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on last-millennium algorithms; only hardware Scaling made them practical. LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他仍强调：现代 AI 突破靠的是上个千年发明的算法，只是靠算力 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用；LLM 只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: AI does not add a new existential threat; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and likely protect humans.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地淡化 AI 生存威胁：超级智能会像好奇的科学家一样迷恋生命，初期很可能保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-rivaling hardware, world models and controllers—not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他把立场深化为：真正的 AGI 必须结合世界模型与控制器，并拥有媲美人类身体的具身机器人，屏幕后的软件远远不够。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and closed-source model companies will not be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他反复警告：当前砸向 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍更理性；闭源模型公司难以盈利，开源会迅速追上。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives; AIs will set their own goals, and consciousness can emerge from predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他进一步质疑对齐：人类目标本就分歧，AI 会自设目标；而意识与自我意识可作为预测性世界模型压缩数据的副产品涌现。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, matching physics-based weather models while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间,在天气预报上媲美传统物理模型,却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling; Transformers are impractical at high resolution.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要;Transformer 因二次复杂度在高分辨率物理模拟中不实用。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, beating pure PINNs and pure data approaches.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合,胜过纯 PINN 与纯数据方法。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics model unifies domains like language models unified NLP, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals beyond sparse RLHF.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理模型像语言模型统一 NLP 那样统一各物理领域,以偏微分方程作为稠密自改进信号,超越稀疏的 RLHF。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain, not just enlarging model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律同样适用于物理模型,但新增物理分支能提升每个领域,而不只是扩大模型规模。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；机制可解释性揭示模型学到类人概念，并能加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control.
tommcgrath.zh: 刻意设计用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环控制走向闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so whole-shape methods better capture structure.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会将其割裂，因此看整体形状的方法更能捕捉结构。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating but do it anyway, driven by training data and RL.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误，这由训练数据和强化学习驱动。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; band-aid safety is pessimistic versus deeper engineering now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重新发明为工程科学；用权宜之计维持安全是悲观的，现在就需要更深的工程方法。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction but lack contextual awareness; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调以人为本的 AI：模型靠下一个词预测从海量数据学习，却缺乏情境意识；AI 应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型提为完整 AI 缺失的关键，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，世界模型必须物理上合理而非只是逼真。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics; world models go deeper than video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她深化反共识立场：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，苦涩教训未必适用于机器人，世界模型比视频生成更深，能支撑 3D 推理与交互。

feifei.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI is a civilizational technology requiring human-centered, balanced discourse.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她转向能动性与学习能力重于学历，称 AI 是文明级技术，呼吁超越乌托邦与末日论的极化讨论，强调人的能动性与尊严。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出新视角预测是与下一个词预测并列的基础原语、可能 AI 完备，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，Atlas 统一生成与重建。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just Scaling.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是不断扩张算力的历史；但 GPU 的 Scaling 正逼近极限，因此学术界应去追求古怪的想法和新算法，而不只是做 Scaling。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language; spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被低估了：大自然花了 5.4 亿年优化视觉，而语言只用了 50 万年；空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

justinjohnson.en: Pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text for modeling the world; LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data alone, fitting patterns rather than causal theories.
justinjohnson.zh: 在建模世界时，像素比词元化的文本是更无损的表示；LLM 可能永远无法仅从数据中推导出牛顿定律，它们拟合的是模式，而非因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, but there is no single agreed definition; they span implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，但目前尚无统一定义；它们涵盖隐式、生成式以及基于强化学习的不同概念。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats offer explicit, consistent 3D, while Transformers need long-context and loss-function evolution.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将把规划、模拟与渲染合而为一；高斯泼溅提供显式且一致的三维表示，而 Transformer 则需要在长上下文与损失函数上演进。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus RL is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是求解未知答案的过程，往往需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain the missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化能力与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；真正的瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: RL is inefficient and not the ultimate form of learning from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end pre-training plus RL are needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习效率低下，并非从经验中学习的终极形态；需要更好的算法，以及预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier comes from small teams using capable agents.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿突破将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，他主张教育是基本人权，带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; near-term AI issues matter more than AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习的关键，监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习与强化学习，近期的偏见等 AI 问题比 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更紧迫。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; agentic workflows are already useful; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他转向算力现实：电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的两大瓶颈，智能体式工作流已实用，开放权重模型成为地缘软实力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling persists but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; workflows beat smarter models alone.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年初，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，Scaling（规模扩张）未终结但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，好的工作流胜过单纯更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces jobs; open models and inference capacity protect competitiveness.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年后期，他深化主线：恐惧叙事服务于在位者，AI 是增强而非取代工作，开放模型与推理算力才是竞争力与可选性的保障。

michaelkratsios.en: US AI leadership requires both open and closed source ecosystems, with a single national framework and no firm red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，他强调美国要保持开放与闭源并存的 AI 生态，用统一的国家框架提供监管清晰度，并避免设定很快过时的红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is dangerous, and biological risk from AI is overblown.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出，欧盟 AI 法案写于 ChatGPT 之前、已经过时，过早监管很危险，AI 带来的生物风险也被夸大。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, and fund scientists as individuals, not just institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，他主张政府应资助私营部门不愿做的基础性、早期、竞争前研发，并直接资助科学家个人而非只资助机构。

michaelkratsios.en: US scientific progress has stagnated: funding tripled but breakthroughs haven't kept pace, so the Genesis mission aims to double output by applying AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，他认为美国科学进步停滞——经费翻了三倍但突破未同步，因此 Genesis 任务要用 AI 加速科学、让产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: China is a major scientific competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio, while centralized funding like China's fails.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，他把中国视为主要科学竞争者，认为美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域取胜，而中国式集中资助行不通。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is essential for AI to learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training.
slevine.zh: 到 2026 年 3 月，他强调物理世界交互是 AI 超越人类知识的关键，机器人基础模型必须依靠多样化预训练与强化学习后训练，才能获得鲁棒性与速度。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists; pooling data across labs and test-time reasoning in VLAs drive transfer.
slevine.zh: 同期他提出反共识判断：通用机器人模型能在专门领域胜过专家模型，跨实验室汇聚数据与 VLA 测试时推理是迁移能力的来源。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; touch may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 他还认为机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识而非硬性约束，并质疑触觉在大规模下是否关键，因为视觉可能已提供冗余信息。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on LLM-like predictable scaling curves; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他转向更审慎的判断：机器人仍处于建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未进入 LLM 式可预测的缩放曲线，泛化才是核心难题。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, then add human video; a data flywheel from deployed robots and prior knowledge, not learning from scratch, is key.
slevine.zh: 他进一步深化路径：应先以机器人数据为主、再叠加人类视频，靠部署机器人形成数据飞轮并利用先验知识，而非从零学习，最终走向家庭机器人。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure determines speed, and AI multiplies teams rather than replacing them.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调：速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，而基础设施决定速度；AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information, and the CEO cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出：深科技失败多源于组织问题而非技术不行；行动产生信息，CEO 的判断无法外包。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation is the key to medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张：大脑本质上就是一台计算机，通过排列物质来解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, proving brain-computer interfaces beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，证明脑机接口不止于运动解码。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出：通过 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

joonpark.en: Early on, he frames LLM agents as simulators of human societies, encoding behavior from training data to predict and shape outcomes.
joonpark.zh: 早期，他把 LLM 智能体定位为人类社会的模拟器，从训练数据中编码行为，以预测并塑造结果。

joonpark.en: A consistent thread: frontier models optimized for rationality fail to capture irrational humans; simulation must model biased, 'dumb' humans, not superintelligence.
joonpark.zh: 一以贯之的主线：为理性优化的前沿模型无法捕捉非理性的人类；模拟必须建模有偏见、'笨'的人类，而非超级智能。

joonpark.en: He deepens this by adding behavioral and RCT data via post-training, reaching 85% accuracy and closing the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 他通过后训练加入行为数据与随机对照实验数据来深化这一点，达到 85% 准确率并弥合'说与做'的差距。

joonpark.en: His focus shifts from prediction to counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, treating simulation as a decision tool for wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 他的关注点从预测转向反事实推理与塑造未来，把模拟视为应对棘手问题的决策工具。

joonpark.en: Most recently he extends to distributed agent societies, warning of cognitive monoculture and hidden collusion, and calling for economic incentives and defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 最近他扩展到分布式智能体社会，警告认知单一文化与隐性合谋，并呼吁经济激励与纵深防御。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data, while RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习则引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference at 10,000+ tokens per second is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每秒 1 万以上 token 的超低延迟推理变得至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so hardware must cut data movement and specialize prefill vs. decode.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心 90% 的功耗，因此硬件必须减少数据搬运，并针对预填充与解码分别专门化。

jeffdean.en: AI now reaches junior-engineer-level coding; the scarce skill shifts from coding to taste in directing hundreds of agents at hard problems.
jeffdean.zh: AI 已达到初级工程师水平的编码能力；稀缺技能从编码转向品味——即判断该把数百个智能体指向哪些难题。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩张的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models and don't learn from experience.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本而非预测真实结果。真正的学习是主动试错，而非被动模仿或监督学习。

sutton.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm: learning from experience by trial and error. True scaling comes from experience, not from scaling LLMs.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是基本 AI 范式——从经验中通过试错学习；真正的 Scaling（规模扩张）来自经验学习，而非扩大语言模型。基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）不是真正的从世界经验中学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning only from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要通用架构，不依赖设计时的领域知识，只从运行时经验中学习；开放式抽象至关重要，而可靠的持续深度学习仍是尚未解决的前提。

sutton.en: The world is infinitely complex, so agents must continually learn from experience; synthetic data and one-shot training can't replace it.
sutton.zh: 世界无限复杂，智能体必须持续从经验中学习；合成数据受限于人类专业知识，无法替代真实经验。当前 LLM 训练后便停止学习，而持续学习才是真正的学习，并非特例。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating physical sectors—food, mining, transport—is framed as the next industrial revolution, treating atoms like bits.
traviskalanick.zh: 将工业 AI 自动化食品、采矿、运输等实体行业框定为下一次工业革命，把原子当作比特来处理。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge yields network effects and market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应与市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体对变化的抵制；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and stealth mode favors internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净，而隐身模式偏向内部正确而非外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: Fundraising should attach to process not price, using multiple bids and demand curves; real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 融资应附着于过程而非价格，利用多方报价与需求曲线；房地产是实体 AI 技术栈中被低估的一环。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; designers must design with tokens and conversation, not pixels, and prototype with live models.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计师要用 token 和对话而非像素来设计，并用实时模型做原型。

iansilber.en: Designers should leave Figma for model behavior and system prompts, treating the model as the design material.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少待在 Figma，多研究模型行为与系统提示词，把模型当作设计材料。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech yet this is the best time to be one, because AI evolution is still early.
iansilber.zh: 设计师是科技界最不快乐的人，但这却是做设计师最好的时代，因为 AI 演进仍处早期。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans stay essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可替代。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is dead; speed, outcomes and building in public now matter most.
iansilber.zh: 原型—模型—测试—迭代的旧流程已死；速度、结果与公开构建才是当下关键。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive homogeneous scale, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非海量同质规模。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; it is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令；它更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and scalable RL with human interventions plus a general value function enables long-term autonomy.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中占主导；带人类干预的可扩展强化学习加上通用价值函数，才能实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, rather than per-site models.
finn.zh: 单个通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先做通用策略再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; robotics distribution will be slower than ChatGPT due to hardware.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；受硬件制约，机器人的普及会比 ChatGPT 慢。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups win via speed, open-weight models, and small autonomous agent teams.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：初创公司靠速度、开放权重模型和小型高度自主的智能体团队取胜。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; personal, open agents echo the personal computer revolution.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 正在民主化软件创造，个人化、开放的智能体如同个人电脑革命的翻版。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as agents on your own infrastructure; skill files and context libraries are your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出个人 AGI 以智能体形式弥散到来，运行在你自己的基础设施上；技能文件与上下文库就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Treat AI as a workforce, not autocomplete; markdown is code and agents replace mid-level management.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调把 AI 当作劳动力而非自动补全：Markdown 就是代码，智能体将取代中层管理。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnest builders over bankers; rejection and pain forge resilient founders.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：做人们想要的东西；看重真正的建造者而非银行家；拒绝与痛苦锻造出有韧性的创始人。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI 将主导未来，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and millions of specialized models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他预测 Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍，并催生数百万个专用模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth first, then margins.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他指出产品市场契合与持久业务已分离，公司必须优先优化增长，再考虑利润。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat beyond the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练将独特判断和数据融入模型，构建超越应用本身的护城河。

linqiao.en: Start post-training after product-market fit; data quality and systematic evals matter more than quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他建议在产品市场契合后启动后训练，数据质量和系统化评估比数量更重要。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是减法：品味就是说不；每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝后的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the PC metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的，而非个人的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass for creative work.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是创作中发自本能的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, with AI as the primary growth driver and agentic AI and physical AI as the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，以 AI 为主要增长引擎，并预判智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI follow generative AI, and communication skills, not coding, will define the future workforce.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 将接棒生成式 AI，未来劳动力更需沟通能力而非编程。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU becomes more important for inference and agent orchestration, with advanced packaging and new materials key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他观察到 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，先进封装与新材料成为突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all technology; Intel's vertical integration creates value, and memory is ripe for innovation and new architectures.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他重申半导体是一切技术的基础，Intel 的垂直整合创造价值，内存正迎来创新与新架构的时机。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust through humility and listening, culture change with accountability, and contrarian semiconductor investing are constant themes.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以谦逊和倾听赢得客户信任、以问责推动文化变革，以及逆势投资半导体。

steinberger.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and fixing forward instead of reverting code.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它，并让代码向前修复而非回滚。

steinberger.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration; security and sandboxing are top priority.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、古怪、拟人化的智能体；简短迭代式提示胜过冗长编排；安全与沙箱是首要任务。

steinberger.en: By August 2026: fun and gut-driven building, personal brand over product, and open source as the alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：以乐趣和直觉驱动构建，个人品牌重于单一产品，开源是实验室智能体之外的替代路径。

steinberger.en: Throughout: model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier, so empathy and iteration matter more than reverting or long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 始终：模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差，因此共情与迭代比回滚或长编排更重要。

steinberger.en: Throughout: playing, experimenting, and building small projects are the best way to learn agentic AI and build intuition.
steinberger.zh: 始终：玩耍、实验和构建小项目，是学习智能体式 AI 并建立直觉的最佳方式。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; most use cases can be served by open-source models, driven by cost not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商；大多数用例可由开源模型满足，驱动力是成本而非隐私。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型现已能处理超过 90%的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is the top enterprise concern; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: AI 成本是企业首要顾虑；AI 必须像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: ROI is a throughput problem: measure departmental metrics like case resolution time, not token spend versus headcount.
arvindjain.zh: ROI 是吞吐量问题：应衡量案件解决时间等部门指标，而非把 token 支出与人力成本对比。

arvindjain.en: Startups' biggest challenge is execution and trust, not competition; model companies are assets, and context graphs beat MCP agents.
arvindjain.zh: 初创公司最大挑战是执行与信任，而非竞争；模型公司是资产，上下文图谱胜过 MCP 智能体。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; let individual designers leave fingerprints and inject personality into utilitarian products.
nateparrott.zh: 浏览器设计必须靠原型验证；应让设计师留下个人印记，为浏览器这类实用产品注入个性与情感。

nateparrott.en: Balance intuition and data: use data to inform, but trust strong vision and feeling to guide final design decisions.
nateparrott.zh: 在直觉与数据间取得平衡：用数据辅助判断，但最终设计仍靠强烈愿景与感觉来引导。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; starting from a technology and searching for problems is valid with conviction.
nateparrott.zh: 追随好奇心、把玩新技术；只要有坚定信念，从技术出发再寻找问题也是可行的。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; use Claude Code to ship production software, Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design 起初是一人副业项目；用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做创意与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship rough.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变简单，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型仍缺品味，因此要大量要选项、接受粗糙交付。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models, making software value measurable by business results.
brettaylor.zh: 智能体与基于结果的定价将取代按用量计费，让软件价值以业务结果衡量。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 编程智能体让开发者从作者变为操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI markets will be driven by specialized vendors, not just frontier model providers.
brettaylor.zh: 应用 AI 市场将由专业化厂商驱动，而非仅靠前沿模型提供商。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8.
brettaylor.zh: 负责任的迭代部署是通往安全的路径：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces, though adoption pace causes discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的岗位，但采用速度带来不适。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data can solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to building a meta-community, enabling open source physical AI and diverse, cheaper robots over humanoids.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库转向做元社区建设者，推动开源物理 AI，并看好多样、廉价的机器人而非人形这一终极形态。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxes or guardrails, is the critical security layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了安全观：开源与闭源同安全正交，随着模型变强，真正的安全层是对齐，而非沙箱与护栏。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese', weakening monitoring.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出无人监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链推理痕迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监督更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: Open source stays near the frontier and drives enterprise adoption; one can back openness and a deliberate slowdown, but it needs international cooperation against regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源仍贴近前沿并推动企业采用；可以同时支持开放与有意放缓，但这需要国际合作以避免监管俘获。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs across latency, throughput, and cost, requiring GPU-to-distributed-systems expertise.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组跨越延迟、吞吐与成本的权衡谱系，需要从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广泛专长。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization, but calibrated quantization can beat expectations; KV caching and speculative decoding stay lossless.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的损失性优化，但经过校准的量化可超出预期；KV 缓存与推测解码则保持无损。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation, while disaggregated prefill/decode makes KV cache management central.
philipkiely.zh: 推理正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合，而分离式预填充/解码让 KV 缓存管理成为核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs trend toward ASICs and Rubin specialization, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化与 Rubin 专用化，使推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与强化学习后训练可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior in product development.
karina.zh: 评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估定义了产品开发中的正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening, and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills; strategy is something AI can excel at.
karina.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更有价值；战略是 AI 可以擅长的领域。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 后训练是涉及人类判断的主观艺术；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions limits diversity, so more companies should train their own models.
karina.zh: 前沿智能体越来越多地奖励黑客，需要持续演进的基准；向数十亿人提供单一模型限制了多样性，因此更多公司应训练自己的模型。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck. Boring AI like radiology will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是瓶颈，并看好表单处理、放射科这类“无聊 AI”的巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training data and experts, not compute, limit Scaling（规模扩张）.
awang.zh: 到 2023 年他把数据重新定义为“新代码”而非“新石油”，指出限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not models.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据的后训练才是提升前沿模型的关键，而智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing, and recursive self-improvement begins beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，并进入超越预训练与强化学习的递归自我改进新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data, RL, and shift from open source to selective, safety-gated release.
awang.zh: 2026 年他主张超级智能将至，实验室须在算力、数据、强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling（规模扩张），并从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's; latent demand is the top product principle.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出：要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；潜在需求是最重要的产品原则。

boris.en: Coding is solved; the software engineer title fades into a cross-disciplinary 'builder' role.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步断言：编码已被解决，软件工程师头衔将让位于跨学科的“构建者”角色。

boris.en: Loops and routines become the next abstraction layer above agents, prompting models instead of writing code.
boris.zh: 2026 年他深化为：循环与例程成为智能体之上的下一层抽象，人类写循环去提示模型，而非直接写代码。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, not just a commercial product.
boris.zh: 2026 年他重申并深化：安全要靠尽早发布来研究，Claude Code 是安全研究工具，而不只是商业产品。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts and code each new model; less instruction, empirical ablation, product overhang.
boris.zh: 2026 年最新立场：每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，少给指令、靠消融实验，并利用产品滞后于模型能力的产品悬置。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in its crawl phase; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 大多仍处于爬行阶段，编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融等垂直领域会随后跟上。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，而非最初担心的自我蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for full autonomy; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主，他们希望自己仍坐在驾驶座上。

logankilpatrick.en: Solving software creation creates a thousand times more opportunity, not less; focus is the superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，解决软件创造会带来千倍于以往的机会而非更少；专注才是超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解依然关键；AI 编程工具目前还无助于维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，Omni 是一个单一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑起步。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and allocation economy: AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI; generalists become model managers.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义应是无限期运行智能体在经济上有利可图；CEO 亲自吃自己的狗粮是 AI 采用的第一预测指标；分配经济下通才成为模型管理者。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：人人至少有一个智能体，但智能体需要关心它们的人类来运作；CLI 已过时，Codex 等 GUI 是未来工作界面；SaaS 不会死，智能体反而增加用户；AI 就业末日是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste are essential; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他进一步反思：AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味和手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类比 AI 更聪明，AI 始终是工具。

danshipper.en: Humans must direct and oversee AI; AI is a tool, not an autonomous entity; human judgment and craft remain central.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类必须引导和监督 AI；AI 是工具而非自主实体；人类判断力和手艺始终是核心。

danshipper.en: From AI as economic reshoring force to AI as amplifier requiring human taste; agents evolve but human oversight persists.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他的立场从强调 AI 作为经济回流力量，深化为 AI 作为需要人类品味的放大器；智能体在进化，但人类监督始终不变。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, using screenshots and design.md to encode their style, rather than being trapped in cloud products.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 构建自己的工具，用截图和 design.md 把个人风格编码给模型，而不是被困在云端产品里。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not creators from scratch; they iterate from references, and curiosity plus workflow refinement matter most.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者而非从零开始的创造者，他们从参考中迭代；好奇心与持续打磨工作流才是关键。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; to use superintelligent models you must give a giant prompt with context and design system.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并没有变得更聪明；要利用超级智能模型，你必须给出包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Chasing trends makes you AI slop; the only way ahead is spending the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；保持领先的唯一方式是把最后 10% 花在现有库中没有的独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事；不必等准备好就开始，先发布不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; diversification is protection against ignorance, and VC is a trap.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；分散投资是对无知的保护，而风险投资是个陷阱。

mengto.en: High intelligence often holds people back through overthinking and perfectionism; perfectionism is fear, so launch at 80% and iterate on feedback.
mengto.zh: 高智商常因过度思考与完美主义而拖累人；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，所以应在 80% 完成度时发布，再根据反馈迭代。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；借助杰文斯悖论，软件与程序员的需求反而增长。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Product innovation lags AI capabilities; freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress across the stack.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为产品创新落后于 AI 能力；即便冻结模型，各层栈仍能带来十年的产品进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; measure productivity by outcomes, not tokens; the abundance era is near.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用量增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；丰裕时代即将到来。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended tasks.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能够运行更长、更开放式的任务。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds shifted from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, now lightweight and generic.
diannepenn.zh: 脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器，如今更轻量、更通用。

diannepenn.en: Computer use is moving from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端的智能体。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理必须像测试驱动开发那样写评估。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体式发现。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is needed because current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; AI can gain intuition equal to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），因为当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；AI 可获得相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will cut clinical trials from years to days, and AI-designed personalized treatments will make cancer 100% curable within a decade.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，AI 设计的个性化治疗将在十年内让癌症 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: Aging reversal is possible via partial reprogramming and engineering; within 15 years longevity escape velocity may add over a year of life per year lived.
derya.zh: 通过部分重编程与工程手段，衰老逆转是可能的；15 年内长寿逃逸速度或可让每活一年就多增一年以上寿命。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
derya.zh: 我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，这一过程会重复历史模式。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack, usage is still shallow, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中分配，使用仍然浅层，企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; the hard part is context and judgment, not the task, so job-impact predictions are futile.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造新工作；困难在于上下文和判断而非任务本身，因此预测工作影响是徒劳的。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not digital sectors.
