qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5-10 年内体现在农业、采矿和建筑领域，而非数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI stems from misunderstanding; learning its limitations reduces anxiety.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为对 AI 的恐惧源于误解，了解其局限性可减少焦虑。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles and environments.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出 Transformer 使物理 AI 模型能泛化到不同车辆和环境。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调最困难的部分不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI, addressing the global economy's physical sectors.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出物理 AI 将比数字 AI 产生更大的经济影响，解决全球经济的物理部门。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which is more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为自主性的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling more efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演变为神经模拟，从而更高效地训练物理 AI。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; every output is a hallucination, some right, some wrong.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们无法知道自己不知道什么；每一次输出都是幻觉，只是有的对、有的错。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）会撞上数据墙与算力上限；进一步进展需要推理、搜索与模块化。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks; linguistic structure may return.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型；语言结构可能重新成为有用表征。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专门化智能体，以避免上下文过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Bugs and sharp edges signal product-market fit, not failure; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 漏洞和粗糙边缘是产品市场契合的信号而非失败；网页对智能体不友好，API 优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders orchestrate AI agents as a team; founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 单人创始人把 AI 智能体编排成团队；创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞见才是真正的护城河。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and agents can even project-manage human tasks.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，智能体甚至能反向管理人类任务。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly iteration; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张产品经理放弃长期路线图、转向每周甚至每日迭代；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%, to deliver real leverage; simple setups beat over-customized AI workflows.
catwu.zh: 他坚持自动化必须做到 100%可靠而非 95%，才能产生真正杠杆；简单配置往往胜过过度定制的 AI 工作流。

catwu.en: Safe AGI as a shared mission unifies Anthropic, enabling fast cross-org decisions and autonomous team principles.
catwu.zh: 从 2026 年 4 月到 7 月，他始终把安全 AGI（通用人工智能）作为统一 Anthropic 的使命，支撑快速跨组织决策与团队自主原则。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste; Claude Code and Claude Tag build themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去、专注产品品味；Claude Code 与 Claude Tag 在内部自我构建，Claude Tag 承担了 65%的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment and eval suites.
catwu.zh: 他进一步深化：前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，转而依赖模型判断与评估套件。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good—a codebase is a spec—and humans should leave the code review loop for outer-layer changes.
catwu.zh: 他提出反共识立场：重写如今是好事，代码库就是规格说明；外层变更应让人类退出代码审查循环，由 Claude 全权审查。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统做不到的联想式召回与更深层组合。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models per user or team, cutting inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是面向每个用户或团队的众多个性化模型，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the next paradigm, not scaling with more compute alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才是下一个范式，而非仅靠更多算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; continual learning runs on-device with user-owned weights.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力应被用于企业知识；持续学习将在端侧运行，权重由用户拥有和培育。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味与独特声音成为关键差异化。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to over-reliance.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，随着学徒制让位于过度依赖，人才管道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, so the co-intelligence back-and-forth prompting era is over.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 独立执行长任务，来回提示的共智能时代已经结束。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; organizations need a leadership, lab, and crowd model to harness AI's jagged frontier.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；组织需要领导层、实验室与大众的模型来驾驭 AI 参差不齐的能力边界。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation's paradox deepens: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so experts and small-m management matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论加深：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断它所需的专长，因此专家与小写 m 的管理更重要。

bosworth.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; bottom-up culture is a myth, big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他强调沟通即工作，影响力只能通过清晰沟通实现；并认为自下而上的文化是神话，大想法来自高层自上而下。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; world models and embodied AI need scaling laws plus common sense.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他称 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能，但将极大提升人类能力；世界模型与具身 AI 需要缩放定律之外常识与因果。

bosworth.en: Open source AI like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; app model inverts to intent-driven agents.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他认为 Llama 等开源 AI 加速进步并商品化互补层；应用模式将倒转为意图驱动、AI 编排服务的智能体。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws hold; data is the font of value, RL matters more, and frontier-open gap may not narrow.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立，数据是一切价值之源，强化学习作用远超预期，且前沿与开源差距未必缩小。

bosworth.en: Monolithic model era ended; consumers want functionality, not model brands; agentic AI integration is the hard part.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他判断单体模型时代已结束，消费者不关心模型品牌只想要功能；智能体式 AI 强大但集成是难点。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，Ilya 认为深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to the age of research; superintelligence should be a continual learner, not finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的，而非无所不知的成品 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题已转向权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

ilya.en: Neural networks learn representations without explicit rules; next-token prediction is a powerful path to intelligence, but alignment and safety grow harder as models scale.
ilya.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，下一个词预测是构建智能的强大路径，但随模型规模扩大，对齐与安全挑战愈发严峻。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and it will drive productivity booms and price deflation.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，并将推动生产率繁荣与价格通缩。

andreessen.en: Jobs persist longer than tasks; focus on task loss, not job loss, and human workers will be at a premium, not a discount, due to depopulation.
andreessen.zh: 工作比任务存续更久；应关注任务流失而非工作流失，且因人口减少，人类劳动者将溢价而非折价。

andreessen.en: The super-empowered individual combines multiple skills using AI; new media makes the brand the person, and authenticity beats old media's defense-oriented rules.
andreessen.zh: 超级赋能的个体借助 AI 组合多种技能；新媒体让品牌即个人，真实性胜过旧媒体防御导向的规则。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而非仅靠军事规模。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and the real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation.
andreessen.zh: AGI 不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人途中的一个脚注，真正的瓶颈是监管等结构性障碍。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases; only 17% of designers see AI as a threat.
dylanfield.zh: 对既有代码库而言，AI 带来的生产力提升有限；只有 17% 的设计师把 AI 视为威胁。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点至关重要；AI 的输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; design is becoming the new code, visual-first toward production.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于提示词；设计正在成为新的代码，视觉优先将通向生产。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，反而比以往更重要；没有人类掌舵的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年时他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting out time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，主张与长期的人玩长期的游戏，让复利在各方面生效。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, so the US must lead with a light touch.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他对 AI 的立场明显转向：AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯的安全风险，过度监管会扼杀创新，美国应以轻触式监管保持领先。

naval.en: AI is a leverage layer for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software becomes uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆层，vibe coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap, and human agency, not intelligence, becomes the scarce return.
naval.zh: 最近他预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型正逼近前沿模型，人类的回报将从智能转向能动性。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users; PhD not needed for AI success.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可年化复利至 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户；AI 成功不靠博士学位。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer; models specialize not commoditize; coding has infinite ceiling; benchmarks hackable.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层；模型走向专业化而非商品化；编程天花板无限；基准测试可被操纵。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; token value per user key; power bottleneck; orchestration across models/tools/devices; fewer people with AI agents.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活；每用户 token 价值是关键；电力是瓶颈；跨模型、工具、设备的编排；用 AI 智能体以更少人构建公司。

aravind.en: Curiosity drives success; ancient texts describe advanced tech; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 好奇心驱动成功；古籍描述先进技术；AI 取代工作，但人类在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables real-time steering and delegation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来实时转向与任务委派。

ajambrosino.en: Verification, curation and taste become the bottleneck as implementation cost collapses; teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，随着实现成本崩塌，验证、策展与品味成为新瓶颈；团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still fails at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍会失败，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties and best practices persist; PRDs survive when the medium matches the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；当媒介匹配阶段时，PRD 依然存活。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as general knowledge work despite being built for developers; models should get better at deleting code, not just adding it.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型应更擅长删除代码，而非只增加代码。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training must be rebuilt, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练这块肌肉要重建，投入探索的算力甚至多于训练最终产物。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission protect top researchers; alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为人才密度与使命感是留住顶尖研究者的关键，并预判未来 1-2 年模型谋划等对齐风险将成为核心挑战。

markchen.en: Concrete goals: AI interns within 1 year, end-to-end AI research within 2.5 years, automating scientific discovery.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他给出具体目标：1 年内出现 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究，把科研自动化作为最大更新。

markchen.en: Verification is the bottleneck in math; AI capability is jagged, so human-AI collaboration stays essential for frontier work.
markchen.zh: 2026 年在数学领域，他指出验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比；AI 能力参差不齐，前沿研究仍需人机协作。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains, but models lack taste, so humans still drive ideas.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年，他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域强，但模型缺乏品味，创意仍靠人类研究者。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities and embrace breakage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在前沿模型能力的边缘构建、拥抱破坏与迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and agency remain key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从 AI 作为助手、协作者到自主同事的演进出发，强调小团队杠杆增强，但人类验证与能动性仍关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体能做用户能做的一切；难点在于删减功能而非增加功能。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation and dynamic workflows redefine productivity; verification loops and model judgment become essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为长周期委派与动态工作流重新定义生产力；验证闭环与模型判断力变得不可或缺。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他领导 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多能动性与自我认知。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for robust generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式表征击败维数灾难，无监督学习与世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled knowledge, not passive observation.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他主张单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦知识，而非被动观察。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模推动分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he spoke up: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be by construction, not patched, and power must be distributed.
bengio.zh: 2025 年，ChatGPT 之后他公开警示：哪怕 1%的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于构造而非事后修补，权力必须分散。

bengio.en: He now backs Scientist AI: honest Bayesian predictors, no reinforcement learning, mathematical safety guarantees, and global coordination against power concentration.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他转向 Scientist AI：诚实的贝叶斯预测器、不用强化学习、具备数学安全保证，并以全球协调对抗权力集中。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI narrows hypothesis space but doesn't replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 只是缩小假设空间，不会取代科学家。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; perfect interpretability isn't necessary for useful AI in science, and trust will develop like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立信任至关重要；可解释性不必完美，科学 AI 的信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture was the opposite of the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough, drove progress.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的专用架构与“苦涩教训”相反，进步来自许多中等突破而非单一突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 只是特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

jumper.en: AI tools help scientists work faster and enable resource-limited settings, but science remains hypothesis testing, not mechanistic explanation.
jumper.zh: 始终贯穿：AI 工具帮助科学家更快工作、赋能资源有限地区，但科学仍是假设检验，而非必须提供机制解释。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership lessons center on trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms and kindness are strategic tools.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力经验聚焦信任、吃自己的狗粮与使命对齐；作战室与善意都是战略工具。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新的约束。

fiona.en: Planning shifts to just-in-time; six-month roadmaps and design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted reviews.
fiona.zh: 规划转向即时化；六个月路线图与设计文档让位于 PR 与 AI 辅助评审。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs and killing stale processes become norms.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平组织与砍掉过时流程成为常态。

fiona.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, verification, and outcome focus matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性配高问责、验证与结果导向最为关键。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation rigor and the limits of nonparametric methods.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调训练/验证/测试划分以避免过拟合，并指出核方法、决策树、PCA 等方法的理论特性与常见评估错误。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction is a scientific discovery; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety is about specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型时代：认为下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺是迷思，架构已进入后架构阶段，安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范，并给出 AGI 4-50 年的预测。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layered defenses; scaling alone doesn't make models safer; agents introduce prompt injection risks.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御（输入分类器、安全训练、输出分类器、运营安全），Scaling 不会自动带来安全，智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞，并认为可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体实现自动化研究。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; agent security needs configurable guardrails and identity management.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出 AI 红队已超越人类红队，模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，智能体安全需要可配置护栏、身份与权限管理，并预测首次重大提示注入事件将推动 AI 保险普及。

kolter.en: Core thread: rigorous evaluation, skepticism of scaling alone, and focus on real-world security and specification-following.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：重视严格评估与可扩展监督，对单纯 Scaling 保持怀疑，并持续关注真实世界安全与规范遵循，从早期机器学习评估到后期智能体安全一脉相承。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone is insufficient for human-centered design.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，仅靠数据不足以实现以人为本的设计。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature is the best designer and a source of creative cues.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非剥离人性，并融入生活；大自然是最好设计师，也是创造力的线索来源。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack true sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器有传感器却没有真正的感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 约束反而激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills and business fluency more valuable for design leaders.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将把人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创意技能与商业语言能力对设计领导者更有价值。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and common sense needs ideas beyond Scaling.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习通过观察构建世界模型；当前 AI 缺乏常识，解决它需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 因缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划而无法达到人类水平智能，主张 JEPA 与开源 AI 才是出路，AGI 将是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative world models like JEPA.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他进一步断言 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，下一代 AI 突破将来自 JEPA 这类非生成式世界模型，而非 Scaling LLM。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven planning agents.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他立场最激进：LLM 是死胡同，真正的智能需要能在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型，从而构建安全、目标驱动、可规划的智能体，并称下一个十年属于机器人。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键；安全必须在公开中做，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她回顾 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、押注单一大型模型早期并不显然，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布更是一次没有清晰商业案例的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，需要负责任地开发，并为了聚焦而拒绝好想法。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她从部署与对齐转向交互范式：交互模型应基于时间而非回合制，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; governance, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她深化主线：尽可能长时间把人留在回路中，制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that couples generation with verification, grounded in formal languages like Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：一个把生成与验证耦合起来的自我改进推理引擎，以 Lean 等形式化语言为根基。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach math AI or superintelligence; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法通向数学 AI 或超级智能；可靠证明必须依赖形式化验证。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement: verified generation improves performance and sample efficiency over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 验证是性能增益，而非痛苦的要求：相比非形式化方法，经过验证的生成带来性能提升与样本效率。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, since grounding statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难，因为在没有解的情况下为陈述建立根基才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial: AI proofs may be ugly yet converge toward human-like intuition, as with Ramanujan.
carinahong.zh: 人类品味与直觉依然关键：AI 的证明可能丑陋，却能像拉马努金那样收敛到类人的直觉。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ shows generative products need fault-tolerant interfaces.
gustav.zh: 同年他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成，AI DJ 说明生成式产品必须搭配容错界面，让界面匹配算法能力。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost will force new business models.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变：当前对大公司的影响被高估，真正收益来自重建基础设施，而推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and gives users control over algorithms, not more addiction.
gustav.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化为生成式 AI 让产品走向双向对话，并用自然语言把算法控制权交还用户，而非让人更上瘾。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: explain to understand, prototype to synchronize, and optimize for time well spent over engagement.
gustav.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：强烈但可修正的观点——能解释才算理解，用原型同步组织，并以“时间花得值”而非参与度作为优化目标。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling still works, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）有效，但指出带思维链和强化学习的推理模型每单位算力收益更高；经济压力使焦点从一味扩大规模转向部署更小更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; frontier models still fail at simple tasks, and reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor nearby.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数增长；前沿模型仍会败给五岁小孩的简单任务，推理模型表现“参差不齐”——某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了对泛化的担忧：仅靠推理可能不够，因为模型要穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为带推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需海量数据；编程智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；强化学习跨领域泛化但边缘参差，需谨慎监督。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他评价 OpenAI 转向推理是勇敢的赌注且已见回报，但大实验室未来可能难以再次转向；相比存在性风险，系统被黑客攻击等近期风险更紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件即可创建，实现超个性化自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the ideal interaction is asynchronous.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，把人解放出来做创造性工作；理想的交互是异步的。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge only by final impact, and debug the workflow with Claude when it errs.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要紧盯 Claude 监督；只看最终影响，出错时和 Claude 一起调试工作流。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key, and AI will hit junior employees hardest.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资能力与安全才是关键，而 AI 将最冲击初级员工。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity are key levers.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本由内存带宽而非算力主导；批大小和稀疏性是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost, reshaping Scaling laws.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，重塑了缩放定律。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; deterministic latency matters.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；确定性延迟至关重要。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected due to quadratic scaling with bit width.
reinerpope.zh: 由于随位宽的二次方缩放，低精度比预期高效得多。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality are bottlenecks, not just compute; open source drives enterprise adoption; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化观点：效率和数据质量是瓶颈，而不仅是算力；开源推动企业采用；价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced, decentralized, and sovereign; it augments jobs with human-in-the-loop; education must build AI literacy.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权：AI 应被拥抱、去中心化且主权化；以人类在环增强工作；教育须培养 AI 素养。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agentic enterprise software; AGI as one system won't exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他进一步判断：模型正在商品化；差异化转向垂直微调和智能体式企业软件；AGI 作为单一系统不会存在。

mensch.en: Open source, data quality, and European strategic autonomy are consistent threads across his thinking.
mensch.zh: 始终不变的主线：开源、数据质量与欧洲战略自主贯穿他的思考。

jonyive.en: Design's purpose is intimacy and care; wearables will move beneath the skin, and virtual contact cannot replace being together.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调设计的目的是亲密与关怀：可穿戴设备终将走向皮下，虚拟沟通无法替代面对面的共创。

jonyive.en: A constant thread: curiosity and the creative process must be protected; fragile ideas need trust, care, and listening to survive.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 一以贯之的主线：好奇心与创作过程必须被守护，脆弱的想法需要信任、关怀与倾听才能存活。

jonyive.en: Design is driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence and must include joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：设计由价值观与目的驱动而非利润；真正的简洁是表达本质，且必须包含快乐与人性。

jonyive.en: Innovation means moving forward, not breaking things; tradition preserves fire rather than worshipping ashes.
jonyive.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把创新界定为向前推进而非为破坏而破坏：传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: Authenticity and multidimensional performance matter: Ferrari's EV turns constraints into new form, rejecting fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他转向真实性与多维性能：法拉利电动车把约束变成新形态，拒绝伪造的引擎声。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; designers should trust intuition and start from solutions, not problem statements.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；设计师应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题陈述出发。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and set 3-6 month design visions.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了研究-发散-收敛流程；设计师减少做稿，帮助工程师执行，并将设计愿景缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; judgment and authority matter more than taste.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋新人；判断力和权威比品味更重要。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption pace, wait 6 months before new tools, and keep work and users at the center, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师控制 AI 采用节奏，新工具等 6 个月再用，并将工作和用户置于中心，而非 AI 炒作。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are needed.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他强调两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 到现代大语言模型不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新与推理时算力，而非单纯扩大模型。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过载会令模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead; they require exponentially more compute for the same improvement, creating pressure for innovation. Post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为缩放定律并未失效，只是同等提升需要指数级算力，这倒逼创新；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision is unsolved.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; post-training and RL remain a green field, and agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他延续 Scaling（规模扩张）信念，但指出持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；后训练与强化学习仍是广阔蓝海，智能体记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待它们；模型福祉会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need a stable core identity with good traits, yet adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 模型需要具备良好特质的稳定核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning, but lacks real-world experience—childlike and unique.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，却缺乏现实经验——因而像孩子般独特。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导，更多自主判断的空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility risks poor generalization and weakens the model's judgment.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性有泛化不良的风险，并会削弱模型的判断力。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量比算法选择重要十倍，开源后训练可逼近前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are a 'scope'; verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化与推理时扩展曲线只是“障眼法”，更好的验证器比并行算力更关键。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理扩展，预训练只是昂贵的初始化。

lambert.en: Open models will engine the next decade of AI research, though they lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将驱动未来十年的 AI 研究，但最佳开放模型仍落后闭源前沿模型 6 到 9 个月，中国实验室以战略开放主导开源生态。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; Scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来但必须维持熵以避免模型崩溃，并认为经蒸馏的认知核心可小于 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; this is the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；并强调这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and the cognitive core should be stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：当前强化学习很糟、合成数据会崩溃，认知核心应剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: Since December I haven't typed code; the bottleneck is skill in directing agents, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他说自去年 12 月起不再手写代码，瓶颈变成指挥智能体的技能，并强调可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are key.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的核心缺口，主张无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索，并关注强化学习的样本效率与动态任务。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robotics needs intrinsic rewards and model disagreement.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他反共识地指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，真实机器人需要内在奖励与模型分歧驱动的可微好奇心。

pathak.en: Sim-to-real transfer often hides engineering; auto-tuning simulators and 2D manifold reasoning are more efficient than heavy 3D.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为仿真到现实的迁移常依赖隐藏工程，主张自动调参仿真器，并认为 2D 流形推理比体素 3D 更高效。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the recipe for a universal brain.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他将机器人视为数据问题，提出在多样数据上预训练、在真实数据上后训练，以构建通用大脑。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous testing and a data flywheel.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化为部署是首要技术挑战，机器人无法像软件一样扩张，需要严格测试与跨垂直领域的数据飞轮。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一系列里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，随着系统变强，对齐成为紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是关键里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而能力测量正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may mean we are close; AI safety progress is now guaranteed by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求保证，而不只是伦理。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool providing interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；思维链监控是提供可解释性的关键对齐工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

carlpei.en: Survival first: startups must pace themselves, start simple, and build brand as core, not afterthought.
carlpei.zh: 生存优先：初创公司必须控制节奏、从简单产品起步，把品牌建设当作核心而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 硬件利润率最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用型 AI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is hype; focus on user pain points, with AI as an ingredient, not a marketing topic.
carlpei.zh: 多数 AI 是炒作；应聚焦用户痛点，把 AI 当作配料而非营销话题。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based; agents act proactively once trust and privacy are solved.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在信任与隐私解决后主动执行任务。

carlpei.en: Design and efficient marketing arbitrage differentiate challenger brands in mature, homogeneous categories.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟同质化的品类中，设计与高效营销套利是挑战者品牌差异化的关键。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，AV 3.0 可能把智能移到车外。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步强调：Scaling 一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, human interaction, and personalization in driving models.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯认为语言集成能改善驾驶模型的表征、推理、人机交互与个性化。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持量产消费车内置传感器会超越 Robotaxi；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达。

kendall.en: End-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now the winning approach; autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复指出：端到端学习十年前被嘲笑，如今已是胜出路径；自动驾驶靠 Scaling 现有方法即可解决，无需新突破。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年强调：高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才驱动真正的 AI 进步，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年判断：AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM、仅靠下一个词预测可能无法抵达，需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model rules all; every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年提出：前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切；每家公司最终都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo can be gamed and cause regression; sophisticated human evals are the gold standard.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年深化：Elo 等基准可被钻空子并导致模型退步，精细的人类评估才是黄金标准。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety trumps accuracy; human judgment is more critical as models hallucinate and confabulate.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年延伸至医学：安全优先于准确；随着模型幻觉与虚构，人类判断比以往更关键。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; chat is not the future interface, like MS-DOS before Windows. The model is the product, iterated like software.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，聊天不是未来界面，就像 Windows 之前的 MS-DOS；模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他主张安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发要最大程度加速。

turley.en: AI should amplify human capability, not replace humans; keep users in the driver's seat.
turley.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之：AI 应放大人类能力而非取代人类，让用户始终掌握方向盘。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进各占三分之一。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富含可供性的产品；推理模型只有无缝产品化才具变革性。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs hint at AGI, and learning from video can train agents without costly RL.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具；认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，并主张从视频中学习，从而绕开昂贵的强化学习。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial AI; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not only from large models.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性是造出有益技术的前提，并提醒大模型虽令人兴奋却并非全部，根本性创新可以来自任何地方。

nando.en: The goal stays AI that augments scientists and laborers, creating new symbols and knowledge to solve energy, climate and economic problems.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，一以贯之的主线是：AI 应增强科学家与劳动者，创造新的符号与知识，去解决能源、气候与经济问题。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，视其为当下最大挑战，并直言安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogged legacy issues and gender gaps, and local-language models can transform education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而跨越了历史包袱与性别差距，本地语言模型有望变革教育；最大障碍是研究者相信自己能申请顶尖机构。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs needs clear decisions and empowered designers; don't innovate on interaction design—use familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张不惜一切代价追求速度，这需要清晰决策与赋权设计师；不要在交互设计上创新，要用熟悉模式换速度。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 库；不是每个界面都要完美，要追求投入产出比。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and give designers ownership.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器：创始人必须说清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并把决策权交给设计师。

henrymodisett.en: Brand signals quality and recruits talent; people join a brand, not a company—invest early and avoid rigid design crits.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为品牌既传递质量又招募人才；人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此要尽早投入，并避免僵化的设计评审。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; it grounds knowledge and reduces hallucinations, and embodied worlds provide infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：具身能为知识提供基础、减少幻觉，且当互联网高质量 token 耗尽时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk; RL handles low-level control while LLMs do high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top, with unsupervised learning doing most of the work; simple and elegant solutions scale better than complex modular approaches.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，大部分工作应由无监督学习完成；简单优雅的方案比学术界常见的复杂模块化方法更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；来自仿真和世界模型的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away, with home use taking longer.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出：能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来，但家庭使用因安全和非结构化环境需要更久。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；把 AI 当作创意伙伴，代码是唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt, paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务一样波动，需通过快速、粗糙的实验与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: AI-first companies collapse functions; PM, research and sales merge, and design and engineering become one coin.
nadchishtie.zh: AI 优先的公司会让职能坍缩：PM、研究与销售合并，设计与工程成为同一枚硬币的两面。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps outperform specialists and cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才，胜过专家和跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今是基本要求；不采用它就像早期无视互联网一样。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms can boost smaller models.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与推理阶段算法能显著提升较小模型的表现。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, and RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，且 RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时降低 pass@k。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她主张小语言模型借助多样化的合成数据也能变得强大；多元对齐比试图消除互联网偏见更可行。

yejin.en: Language is the best medium for reasoning; open research and collaboration are crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是：语言是推理的最佳媒介；开放研究与协作对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: From scaling skepticism to data-centric small models: her focus shifted from RLHF to synthetic data and pluralistic alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，她的立场从对 Scaling 的怀疑深化为以数据为中心的小模型路线，关注点从 RLHF 转向合成数据与多元对齐。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete as context and adaptive compute allow dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年时，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决「上手」问题并显著提升模型智能，上下文学习类似梯度下降；随着上下文窗口与自适应算力让模型动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models is a new scaling axis with no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI. Reliability, not capability, is the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 到 2025 年，他把语言模型上的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为没有直接上限，预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability; white-collar automation will outpace robotics and biology.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他反复强调：编码因可验证性成为 AI 进展的领先指标与最可行领域，白领自动化将快于机器人与生物学，因为数据可得性更高。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; transformers suffice for AGI, no new architecture needed. Inference compute becomes the bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化立场：进展是指数级的而非停滞，Transformer 足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需全新架构；但到 2028 年推理算力将成为主要瓶颈，限制可用智能体数量。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; work becomes managing fleets of agents. Compute is the new oil.
sholto.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为模型已存在巨大能力盈余，工具与编排比原始智能更重要，未来工作是管理智能体团队、在更高抽象层运作；算力是新的石油，芯片供应是当前瓶颈，世界模型不在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 到 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但还不够实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding; frontier models struggle with bug finding and calibration, so custom models become essential for product quality.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他持续强调基准测试无法代表真实编程，前沿模型在找 bug 和校准上表现不佳，因此自研定制模型对产品质量变得不可或缺。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化立场：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌握主导权，品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更有价值。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; hiring should chase world-class talent slowly, and the IDE market is far bigger.
truell.zh: 2025 年他判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性且需数十年展开，招聘应慢慢寻找世界级人才，而 AI 让 IDE 市场远大于以往编辑器市场。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive learning, but RL lacks hierarchical reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他关注机器人学习：硬件与软件都需突破，自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型提供强信号，但强化学习缺乏分层推理来做长程信用分配。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks; 99.9% reliability is the bar.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他转向样本效率与可靠性：无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率，先验知识应放在数据生成而非硬编码进网络，仓库机器人需 99.9% 可靠性才有真实价值。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他深化对预训练的看法：预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，经最小适配即可迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: generality comes from learning and transfer, not hand-coded assumptions, and the human brain remains far more general than current AI.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：通用性来自学习与迁移，而非硬编码假设；人脑的通用性仍是当前 AI 远不能及的参照。

leike.en: AI safety research is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Focus on alignment and robustness, build skills via hard math, not worry about capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，通过硬核数学课程积累技能，不必过度担忧参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment research. Evaluation easier than generation, so alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究；评估比生成容易，对齐可能比想象中简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute commitments dishonored. Post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐，需要第三方测试和 SB 1047 等监管。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; interpretability as validation to detect deception; uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk.
leike.zh: 始终，他强调对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，可解释性用于检测欺骗，而系统是否真正对齐的不确定性是最大风险。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes AI smarter, though neural networks remain alchemy-like.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）更多算力和数据让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need much longer context windows, and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他转向强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要更长的上下文窗口，混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling will drive progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他深化观点：测试时算力扩展推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习和在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

shazeer.en: Scaling compute and data is a consistent mainline; neural networks remain opaque, and big tech safety concerns slow product launches.
shazeer.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据；神经网络仍不透明，大公司因安全顾虑拖慢产品发布。

shazeer.en: AI's economic impact is underhyped, potentially raising world GDP orders of magnitude; coding is underhyped as it enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他更激进地认为 AI 经济影响被低估，可能让世界 GDP 提升数个量级；编程作为 AI 应用被低估，因为它能自我加速 AI 进步。
